samples.label: Ravi Nair — Autism Spectrum Disorder (mild), age 9

student.raw_notes: Ravi has difficulty with social interactions and unstructured activities. Prefers routines and gets distressed by sudden changes. Exceptional memory for facts and strong in mathematics and science. Communicates well one-on-one.
student.academic_history: Grade 2: 75%. Strong academics, weak social participation.
student.teacher_observations: Works best with structured tasks. Sensitive to noise.
student.parent_concerns: Social isolation during lunch and recess.

student.raw_notes: Rahul has low vision and requires large print materials. Academically strong and highly motivated. Excellent in oral work, mathematics, and science. Struggles with standard printed textbooks. Uses magnifier currently.
student.academic_history: Grade 8: 78%. Strong across subjects with support.
student.teacher_observations: Needs front seating and large print. Very motivated.
student.parent_concerns: Board exam accommodations and college admission.

student.raw_notes: Aryan is profoundly deaf and communicates using Indian Sign Language. Excellent visual learner and strong in mathematics and art. Requires sign language interpreter for all instruction. Active and enthusiastic learner.
student.teacher_observations: Engaged and motivated with ISL interpreter present.

student.school_name: National Institute for Mentally Handicapped, Secunderabad
student.raw_notes: Vikram has mild intellectual disability with strong social skills. Can read simple texts and do basic arithmetic. Excellent at vocational tasks like assembly and sorting. Preparing for transition to vocational training.
student.academic_history: Functional academic skills. Strong in practical workshops.
student.teacher_observations: Motivated and hardworking in vocational activities.
student.parent_concerns: Vocational training and supported employment pathways.

student.academic_history: Grade 5: 74%. Strong across subjects with physical support.
student.teacher_observations: Excellent student. Needs physical access and writing support.
student.parent_concerns: Physical accessibility and assistive technology for writing.
